activationPrerequisites: Replace empty notificationChannels only with actual channel resource names obtained after approved creation/verification; no fictional numeric IDs.
Create policies before a successful baseline watchdog execution; verify the actual metric series and log fields with bounded read-only provider inspection.
Also induce a controlled failed watchdog and a successful pause/stop to prove all three routes. Pub/Sub publish acceptance does not prove email/SMS delivery.

The completion-count threshold handles emitted zeros as well as missing samples. A pure metric-absence condition alone may not catch zeros. Official metric sampling60s and visibility delay up to120s mean this is not a delivery-time SLA.
Monitor setup is not evidence of independent execution; no baseline/no real delivery means controlsVerified stays false.
Notification selection stays empty until owner resolves native conditional-fallback incompatibility; do not attach SMS as routine duplicate.
Scheduler-silence, failed watchdog and successful safety-action conditions each require a real incident and actual recipient delivery proof under the approved notification design.
No overnight owner-response dependency. Initial phase attended; unattended admission blocked until real independent cleanup proof.
